title: Root and category help list immediate children with one-line summaries. Leaf help opens with its summary and teaches the command before execution.
verification: runtime/api/cli/test_command_summaries.py requires a summary of at most 60 characters for every command and group; runtime/api/cli/test_cli_flag_help.py requires help on every argument. Candidate fixtures in runtime/api/cli/test_cli_help_tree.py cover supported registered spellings, alternate routes, prefixes and dual action/group nodes with subprocess, network and source writes refused. This is candidate proof, not live delivery proof. runtime/api/cli/test_adapter_inventory_usage_contract.py compares registered adapters and aliases with real parser actions, including shared-helper options and handwritten error recipes; hidden options and automatic help are excluded. Handwritten command paths must remain registered. This is source-fixture proof. Help lists hyphenated commands by their registered names and splits only group tokens (github actions); a split leaf such as sessions end if empty still runs when typed but never appears as a group, and a typed prefix such as sessions end hints the hyphenated command it starts.
